reasons.plausibility: Using machine-learning potentials to improve liquid-state accuracy is scientifically sound, but the extent of their reliability across the entire composition–temperature space remains partially unproven.
reasons.testability: Comparisons of free-energy calculations and phase-space overlap between EAM and ML-based potentials represent a direct, decisive test to validate or falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a credible and potentially powerful method to address a critical bottleneck in high-entropy alloy modeling and would be valuable for researchers in this field.
